title: Airlock 3D system visualizer scene
description: A scene describes a system as a node graph plus one or more animated flows through it. The renderer (tools/3d-system-visualizer/index.html) consumes this shape directly. Authors write scenes; nobody writes animation code. See ADR-010.

title.description: Display title for the scene. Shown in the scene panel.

description.description: One or two sentences on what this scene shows and who it is for.

nodes.description: Boxes in the scene. Above roughly 20 the graph stops being readable — split into two scenes instead.

edges.description: Connectors between nodes. Every from/to must name an existing node id.

flows.description: Animated walks through the graph. Each consecutive pair in a flow's path must have a matching edge.

id.description: Unique within the scene. Lowercase, digits, underscores. Referenced by edges and flow paths.

label.description: Text drawn on the box. Keep it short — long labels overflow the box face.

pos.description: [x, y, z] in scene units. Convention: x increases left-to-right along the main flow, y stacks layers (0 = primary path, +3 = supporting services, -3 = datastores), z separates parallel branches. Keep neighbours at least 3 units apart or boxes collide.

type.description: Drives box colour and shape. 'external' = outside your trust boundary; 'user' = a human.

description.description: Shown in the inspect panel when the node is clicked.

status.description: 'degraded' glows amber, 'down' glows red, so problems read without clicking.

label.description: What travels along this edge, as a verb phrase: 'reserve stock', 'verify token'.

latencyMs.description: Colours the flow trail cool-to-warm. Omit when unknown — do not invent numbers.

path.description: Ordered node ids. A node may repeat (out-and-back through a gateway is normal).

steps.description: Optional narration, one entry per HOP. A path of N nodes has N-1 hops, so steps must have length N-1 when present. This is what turns an animation into an explanation.

mode.description: 'auto' loops continuously (the original behaviour). 'guided' pauses at each hop and shows the caption with next/previous controls — use it for teaching scenes.

provider.description: Emitted by Generate-LiveScene.ps1 on scenes built from the audit log: which backend the recorded action used. Not hand-authored.

outcome.description: Emitted by Generate-LiveScene.ps1: the recorded result (SUCCESS, WARNING, FAILED). Not hand-authored.

caption.description: One sentence, second person, present tense, no unexplained jargon. This is the line a beginner reads.

detail.description: Optional second line for the reader who wants the why. Safe to skip.
